title: Shared _safe_topic / _is_unsafe_topic guard (WARN-only leaf module)
text: Create NEW leaf module src/pathly_orchestrator/storage_paths.py importing ONLY stdlib (os, logging; NO internal imports so fsm_ops AND runner/argv import it cycle-free). logger=logging.getLogger('pathly.storage'). _is_unsafe_topic(topic)->str|None returns a reason when unsafe: empty/whitespace->'empty'; os.path.isabs(topic)->'absolute path'; any(c in topic for c in ('\\',':'))->'contains path separator' (DO NOT flag bare forward-slash — slash is covered by isabs; flagging it would false-positive a working POSIX sub-path and break behavior-neutrality); splitting on both seps yields a '..' part->'contains traversal segment'. _safe_topic(topic)->str: if _is_unsafe_topic returns a reason, logger.warning('unsafe topic %r (%s); P0 WARN mode — using unchanged', topic, reason) and RETURN topic UNCHANGED (never raise — P1 flips to raise). Pure pass-through. Do NOT add __all__ exporting private names (omit it). Add tests/test_storage_paths.py: normal slug pass-through; absolute forward-slash path WARNs once + unchanged; absolute backslash path same; '../escape','a/../b','' truthy; 'goal-abc12345' None.
acceptance: module imports only stdlib, _safe_topic never raises in P0 (returns input unchanged, WARNs only on unsafe), forward-slash not WARNed unless absolute — verify: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_storage_paths.py -q

title: Additive migration: nullable comms_messages.slug column + partial UNIQUE index
text: In _add_additive_migrations (migrations_incremental.py:43-110) append a comment + tuple ('comms_messages','slug','TEXT') to the column-add list (after line 104, before the closing ]); comment says the column is added here (not 'P1'). The existing try/except ADD COLUMN loop (106-110) skips already-present columns — no loop change. AFTER the for loop completes (after line 110, still inside the function) create a partial UNIQUE index: try: conn.execute("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comms_messages_slug ON comms_messages(slug) WHERE slug IS NOT NULL"); conn.commit(); except sqlite3.OperationalError: pass. The WHERE slug IS NOT NULL clause is REQUIRED. title: ensure_goal_slug: collision-safe goal->slug under the process write-lock
text: NEW supervisor/slug.py (may import db; MUST NOT import http_server). _slugify(text)->str: lowercase, runs of non-[a-z0-9]->'-', strip leading/trailing '-', cap 48 chars; empty->'goal'; cap whole slug to 64 chars max. ensure_goal_slug(conn, goal_id)->str: 'from pathly_orchestrator.db.connection import _get_write_lock' (returns a _WriteGuard context manager — use only 'with _get_write_lock(conn):', never .acquire()). Inside the block: read the goal row's slug+text via read_message_slug (SELECT WHERE id=goal_id AND type='goal'); if slug non-empty return it (idempotent). Else base=_slugify(text)[:48]; candidate=f'{base}-{goal_id[:8]}'; persist via set_message_slug; catch sqlite3.IntegrityError, retry with goal_id[:10],[:12] up to 3 times, then a uuid4 hex tail (truncate to the 64-char cap). All read+write inside the single write-lock block. In comms_messages.py add set_message_slug(conn,message_id,slug) (mirror set_goal_executor:71-78, UPDATE ... SET slug=? WHERE id=?) and read_message_slug(conn,message_id)->{slug,text}|None (read-only, WHERE id=? AND type='goal'); slug.py contains NO inline SQL. Add both helpers to the comms.py re-export shim. tests/test_goal_slug.py: idempotent (twice->same slug, one write); format base[:48]+'-'+goal_id[:8]; empty/symbol text->base 'goal'; two threads racing on the same goal_id converge on ONE slug (no IntegrityError escapes).
acceptance: slug.py exports _slugify+ensure_goal_slug; the latter wraps SELECT+UPDATE in one write-lock + short-circuits on persisted slug; concurrency converges; comms_messages gains set_message_slug+read_message_slug; no inline SQL in slug.py; no http_server import — verify: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_goal_slug.py -q

title: Resolver goals/ probe + create-by-caller, _safe_topic RAISE, thread storage_path through board_run/terminal

title: Create task-dag-post + board-start-context fragments and planning/dag-sketch skill; wire composition.yaml
text: 1) fragments/task-dag-post.md — the SINGLE board-task-POST mechanism (extracted from plan.md Step 6). Structure like comms-post.md (H2 + curl + skip-if-down). H2 '## Posting the task DAG to the Comms Board'. Body assumes $GOAL_ID known (goal exists; do NOT post type=goal): (a) idempotency guard curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/comms/tasks?goal_id=$GOAL_ID' + skip-only-if-THIS-goal-has-tasks (port plan.md 294-301); (b) per-task POST shape type:'task', goal_id:'$GOAL_ID', self-contained text, board, scope, stage, optional integer conv, depends_on array, optional artifact_path/context_refs + the 'executor is NOT on the task' note (port plan.md 423-448); (c) skip-if-down advisory (port 452-456). Agnostic of where titles come from. Do NOT include the advisory-artifact POST block. 2) fragments/board-start-context.md — read-only board context pull at decompose start, gated on goal_id. Body: POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/comms/agent-context (POST not GET — GET returns 405) scoped to {scope, goal_id}; instruct reading existing goal text + open questions before producing tasks; explicit skip-if-down. <=30 lines, advisory. 3) planning/dag-sketch.md — AGNOSTIC body only (NO http://127.0.0.1:8765 or /comms/ strings). Leading ---\n\n--- block fine. Body: 'Decompose the goal into 3-7 concrete, independently-runnable tasks. Each title actionable+specific. Write a one-page DAG_PLAN.md with a ## Tasks table [id | title | depends_on]. Then post each task.' No curl mechanics; no heavy phases; end before completion prose. 4) composition.yaml: add a skills: entry for planning/dag-sketch composing exactly - { name: board-start-context, requires: goal_id }, - { name: task-dag-post, requires: goal_id }, - completion-report (completion-report LAST). progress-logging default applies automatically. Do NOT add a consultation-plan block. 5) tests/test_compose.py: test_dag_sketch_composes_task_post_and_completion — compose_skill('planning/dag-sketch', build_adapter_caps('claude', goal_id='g1')) contains both H2 markers + '## Completion report'; with build_adapter_caps('claude') (no goal_id) the two gated sections absent but completion-report+progress-logging remain. Leave task_dag_post_block_retired UNCHANGED. After editing core files run pathly-setup claude --apply --repair + python -m build; if the build errors on a missing _meta/skills/dag-sketch.yaml, add it to all four adapters.
